metadata.title: Secure Time

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for asserting that time-dependent trust decisions are supported by authoritative, consistent, bounded, and defensible time.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Authoritative time services, synchronization protocols (NTP, PTP, NTS), hardware clocks, and platform time consumers.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Composite trust assertion aggregating platform time capabilities to support secure, time-dependent trust decisions.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Secure Time depends on reliable, protected network transport for time synchronization and distribution.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Secure Time depends on cryptographic identity and trust anchors for authenticated time sources (e.g., NTS, TLS validation).

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Secure Time depends on platform availability and resilience guarantees to prevent time failure cascades.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Manipulation or spoofing of network-based services, including time synchronization channels.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Denial of service affecting authoritative or internal time services, impacting authentication, logging, and enforcement.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Adversary-in-the-middle attacks against unauthenticated or weakly protected time synchronization.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Authenticated and integrity-protected time synchronization (e.g., NTS).

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Redundant authoritative time sources and failover behavior.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Monitoring and correlation of time drift to detect misconfiguration or attack.

metadata.remarks: Secure Time is a composite trust assertion stating that time used for authentication, authorization, auditing, correlation, cryptographic validity, and policy enforcement is authoritative, bounded, observable, and resilient. It introduces no independent controls and exists solely as an aggregate trust claim for use in SSPPs, solution patterns, and system trust decisions.

components.title: Platform Time Cryptographic Validity
components.description: Defines how authoritative time is interpreted by cryptographic systems to evaluate validity windows, freshness, revocation timing, and evidentiary sufficiency.
